'''Estella''' is a 4★ [[Cryo]] [[Guard]] [[Operator]] from [[Endfield Industries]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is a [[Polearm]] user who can apply {{G|Cryo Infliction|Cryo Infliction}} to enemies and coordinate with allies to {{G|Lift|Lift}} them.

==Profile==
"Hngh... Feels like the weight of the entire world has come down at me ... my knees, especially..."<br/>A member of [[Operations Team Z7]] in Endfield, Estella handles intel gathering and communications. Physically weak, and shadowed by misfortune wherever she goes, she sometimes lets her sharp tongue and dark humor push outsiders away. Her dream is simple: to live a peaceful life. After all, she has seen too many people like herself, trapped in a world with no choices, no change, and no future.<br/>A life of danger and extremes has numbed her senses to the world and raised her threshold for stimulation. As a result, she sometimes seeks out harsher forms of challenge — like the pounding rush of heavy metal music. Those rare jolts give her a fleeting sense of change and something real.<br/>Through her work in Endfield, Estella hopes to make the world a little better and life a little easier for those around her.<br/>"I overworked myself again... Hngh... I better appreciate the break while it lasts."
